assessment: Evidence-backed verification inventory for the current sealed candidate. Coverage totals distinguish executed checks from unresolved external limitations; this is not a FULLY VERIFIED claim.

environment.localHostInventory: Windows 11 Pro x64 26H2 build 26300; native host inventoried but excluded from candidate acceptance, reboot, lock, sleep, audio playback, and system theme changes because it is the user's personal machine and no isolated VM or sandbox was available.

suiteAssertionTotals.note: Current candidate-run assertions: 20,100 core across three 6,700 runs; 202 package checks; 837 accelerated GUI assertions; 1,531 installed acceptance checks; 263 exact-production-EXE soak checks; and 2 exact-candidate launch smokes. The GUI suite uses a distinct EYEBREAK_TEST_BUILD binary; deterministic overlap is implementation-level and not direct production HTTPS overlap. Supplemental ARM64 emulation assertions are recorded separately and not double-counted here.

releaseAssessment.confirmedProductDefect: None remains in the exact candidate. Candidate source commit b39f014 fixed the confirmed scaled Work/Break accent-readout clipping and Break-heading viewport/wrapping defects; the exact candidate passed text-scale regressions at 125%, 150%, 200% and 225%. Display-probe failures were traced to missing audio-warning handling and a diagnostic-field bug; the corrected probe passed.
releaseAssessment.exhaustiveVerification: Not fully verified: native Windows 11 x64, reboot/post-login, lock/unlock, sleep/resume, multi-monitor topology, Narrator speech capture, audio output capture, visible legacy Shell balloon, direct production-request overlap, full per-monitor DPI, and exhaustive hover/disabled/selected-state contrasts remain BLOCKED or NOT TESTED.
releaseAssessment.recommendation: READY FOR PUBLICATION APPROVAL WITH DOCUMENTED TESTING LIMITATIONS. Core and GUI regression, installer/upgrade, exact-candidate integrity, custom accents, accessibility protections, resource stability, and current Windows Server x64 display/focus behavior pass. No confirmed release-blocking defect remains. Do not claim FULLY VERIFIED or publish v1.3.0 without separate approval.
